description: Source code for shared channel management in Mattermost, including sharing, updating, unsharing channels, and managing remote invitations and synchronization.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Service class providing shared channel management functionalities.

methods.name: ShareChannel
methods.description: Marks a local channel as shared, creating a SharedChannel record and setting the shared flag.

methods.name: UpdateSharedChannel
methods.description: Updates details of an existing shared channel.

methods.name: UnshareChannel
methods.description: Unshares a channel by deleting its SharedChannel record and unsetting the shared flag.

methods.name: InviteRemoteToChannel
methods.description: Invites a remote to a shared channel, optionally sharing the channel if not already shared.

methods.name: unshareChannelIfNoActiveRemotes
methods.description: Automatically unshares a channel if no active remotes remain.

methods.name: UninviteRemoteFromChannel
methods.description: Removes a remote's invitation from a channel and unshares if no remotes remain.

methods.name: CheckChannelNotShared
methods.description: Checks if a channel is not shared.

methods.name: CheckChannelIsShared
methods.description: Checks if a channel is shared.

methods.name: CheckCanInviteToSharedChannel
methods.description: Verifies if an invitation can be sent to a shared channel, ensuring it originates locally and is not remote.

methods.name: updateMembershipSyncCursor
methods.description: Updates the LastMembersSyncAt timestamp for a shared channel remote.
